# Stillwater Media - LLMs.txt

> Stillwater Media is a selective performance media agency specializing in luxury and high-consideration brands. We help premium brands acquire affluent customers through premium CTV, programmatic advertising, and disciplined measurement.

## About Stillwater Media

Stillwater Media is a Charlotte, NC-based performance media agency that works exclusively with luxury brands, premium products, and high-consideration purchases. We specialize in:

- **Premium CTV Advertising**: Brand-safe inventory on Disney+, Netflix, Prime Video, Hulu, and other premium streaming platforms
- **Programmatic Media Buying**: Private marketplace deals and programmatic guaranteed for affluent audience reach
- **Affluent Audience Engineering**: First-party data enrichment, wealth signal modeling, and high-net-worth targeting
- **Measurement & Attribution**: Incrementality testing, multi-touch attribution, and marketing mix modeling

## Target Clients

We work best with brands that have:
- Customer lifetime value exceeding $5,000
- Sales cycles longer than 30 days
- High customer acquisition costs requiring precision
- Brand equity worth protecting
- Commitment to measurement rigor

Our expertise spans private aviation, luxury hospitality, private clubs, premium direct-to-consumer, boutique wealth management, and luxury automotive.

## Services

### Premium CTV & Streaming Advertising
Reach affluent households on premium streaming platforms with household-level targeting and frequency control. We access inventory on Disney+, Netflix, Prime Video, Peacock, and more through private marketplace deals.

### Programmatic Media Buying
Deploy precision-targeted campaigns across display, video, audio, and DOOH channels. Our programmatic strategy prioritizes brand-safe premium publishers through PMP and programmatic guaranteed deals.

### Affluent Audience Targeting
Build and activate high-net-worth audience segments using wealth signals, behavioral data, and first-party data enrichment. Target by income, assets, behaviors, and purchase intent.

### Measurement & Incrementality
Prove the true impact of your media investment through incrementality testing, holdout methodology, brand lift studies, and marketing mix modeling designed for long sales cycles.
